learning_objective: 🎯 Let's use our feet! Today we will learn how to kick a ball powerfully and stop it safely without using our hands.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at the ball and use the inside of your foot to push it. Swing your leg and kick it towards your friend or the goal!
When the ball rolls to you, do not use your hands! Put your foot gently on top or in front of the ball to stop it like a statue.

fun_activity.title: ⚽ Wall Pass Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Find a safe, empty wall. Kick a soft ball gently against the wall and try to stop it with your foot when it bounces back!

quick_recap: ⭐ Use the inside of your foot for a better and straighter kick.
⭐ Always keep your eyes on the ball when it is rolling towards you.
